name: Open a Brainrot📦
desc:
📦Welcome to Open a Brainrot📦

👍 Like the game and join the group
🧠💥 Buy boxes, open them, and discover your Brainrot! 🤯 Will it be legendary 🌟 or just noob? 😅 Collect them all — maybe even more than one! 🔥📦

🕹️ How to Play:
🛒 Buy a box in the shop
📦 Place it on your plot
🔓 Open it and see what you get
🧠 Collect Brainrots
💰 Sell them for profit!


Remember, your boxes opens when you are offline⭐
